```sql
WITH filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.id AS order_id
    FROM orders o
   WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
     AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
     AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
     AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT pv.product_id,
         pv.id AS variant_id,
         ol.order_id,
         ol.quantity,
         ol.line_total_cents
    FROM filtered_orders f
    JOIN order_lines ol      ON ol.order_id = f.order_id
    JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
),
per_product_order AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         order_id,
         sum(quantity)           AS qty,
         sum(line_total_cents)   AS rev
    FROM lines
   GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
per_product AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         count(*)        AS order_count,
         sum(qty)        AS quantity,
         sum(rev)        AS revenue_cents
    FROM per_product_order
   GROUP BY product_id
),
variant_counts AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         count(DISTINCT variant_id) AS variant_count
    FROM lines
   GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN products p        ON p.id = pp.product_id
  JOIN variant_counts vc ON vc.product_id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY pp.quantity DESC, pp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De herschrijving filtert eerst de orders en groepeert per (product, order) in plaats van een grote DISTINCT-sortering over alle regels, wat de externe sorteringen en tijdelijke schijfschrijfacties uit het plan wegneemt. De join-logica, het cast-gedrag en de kolomvolgorde blijven gelijk aan het origineel. Let op: de ORDER BY heeft geen extra tiebreaker, dus de volgorde van gelijke quantity/revenue-waarden binnen de LIMIT blijft, net als in het origineel, niet deterministisch gegarandeerd.
